scientific_integrity: Proof by exact shortest-path classification, conditional distribution mixture, and polynomial inequalities. Exact-rational checker is finite corroboration only; no independently performed audit.
scientific_limitations: Equilateral complete bipartite metric graphs; independent arclength-uniform points; comparisons fix vertex count, not total length. No variance-ordering claim. The full 1982 Doyle–Graver article was not accessible and historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Stochastic distance ordering and exact transport gaps in equilateral complete bipartite networks
